answer: Each new agent must lock a refundable bond before it can trade, like paying a mooring fee to tie up at a crowded jetty. Honest agents recover the deposit; misbehavior gets it slashed. To run a sybil swarm, an attacker must fund thousands of these escrows at once, draining their capital to its zenith while every slash shrinks the pool. The calm of this economic lagoon holds only because faking each identity costs real, lockable money per head.
